text:
jamie: Heads-up: we need a precise rollout plan for Optics (model routing + per-tenant opt-in). Goals: safe canary, deterministic rollback, CS comms. Who picks up the runbook?

alisa: I can own the runbook. Need KPIs and telemetry fields from product.

jamie: Primary KPIs: error-rate delta <= 0.3pp, p50 latency <= +30ms, token-cost change < +5%. Secondary: CS feedback.

michael: Canary waves suggestion:
- Wave 1: 2% tenant sample (shadow + 10% probe traffic) for 2h
- Wave 2: regional warmup (US-W/US-E) at 10% for 6h
- Wave 3: NA 50% + EU 10% over 24h
Rollback: auto if hard trigger sustained 10m or 3 consecutive alert windows.

sara: Ops: must include per-tenant circuit-breaker, route tracing, and metric tag `optics_canary`. Auto-fallback to `model-v1` on first critical fail.

jamie: Define deterministic rollback rules please.

alisa: Proposed rules:
- Immediate auto-fallback when 5xx increases >0.5pp OR p95 > +200ms for 5m
- Soft breach (error +0.3pp or p95 +100ms for 10m) -> page SRE and hold rollout

michael: Add quality gate: a 30-prompt eval set run every minute; if regressions >2% flagged tokens, pause rollout. Product to own prompts; Ops runs checks.

cs_lead: I'll draft a short CS template for rollback notifications and opt-out instructions.

sara: I'll wire the eval check into preflight and create dashboard panels. Need the prompt CSV.

deploybot: deploy scheduled: optics-canary-1755004321 by alisa at 2024-11-12T09:00:00Z (dry-run). Status: queued. :gear:

jamie: One-click kill-switch required: sets `optics_enabled=false` org-wide, triggers customer notify. Also add fallback hierarchy: 1) model-v1 routing, 2) optics-quant, 3) short-mode token limits.

alisa: Dashboards: per-flag metrics (tokens, latency, error, cost-per-token, fallback-count), filterable by region & tenant.

michael: Sampling seeded by tenant id -> user id. Sticky affinity for A/B stability.

jamie: Schedule a 30-min pre-wave sync with CS and SRE before Wave 1. Can we have runbook + preflight jobs by EOD Friday?

michael: Yes, aiming for it. I'll own sampling and eval harness.

alisa: I'll own dashboards and alerts, and post runbook link here when ready.

jamie: Thanks all. We'll iterate thresholds after Wave 1. :thumbsup:
